scope: Exact s169 recovery morphology; partial support and rise joint-reference planning only. No native execution or task success authority.
input: Actual source observation V3, descriptor, joints, torso pose, COM, ordered native contact and bearing observations. Full native source/energy/ownership validation belongs to the future route wrapper.
modeled_support_plane: Median modeled foot-bottom height among native-present, bearing, ordinary unilateral sites with positive measured normal impulse. Never written to source observations.

goal.horizontal: Predicted measured COM projection centered over the four modeled foot centers
goal.height: modeled support plane + 0.92 * total leg length + foot radius
goal.orientation: level torso preserving measured horizontal heading

objective: Squared world X/Z COM errors + squared torso height error + 0.04 * squared torso-up tilt angle + sum squared positive missing-foot clearance above modeled support plane.

candidate_search.order: scale, forward, vertical, blend; keep first exact tie

foot_targets: Keep current ideal modeled endpoints for bearing feet; lower missing-contact endpoints toward modeled support plane by at most 0.1 * dt * candidate scale. No pose pin or contact relabel.

inverse_kinematics.branches: Both analytic branches; choose smallest squared displacement among individually bounded solutions; positive branch wins exact tie.
inverse_kinematics.unreachable: Reject; never clamp an unreachable cosine to a fake endpoint.

measured_hold: Undefined horizontal heading (projected forward length below 1e-12)
refuse: Wrong descriptor, observation version, dt or source clock
preserved: All task predicates and phase deadlines
Existing actuator impulse and speed caps
Old controller behavior and all consumed records
validation_required: Four exact retained entry references and input immutability
Independent forward reconstruction and rate/limit assertions
